title: Stock Market Edges Higher; Apple Stock Fades Early Gain
text:
Stock Market Edges Higher; Apple Stock Fades Early Gain By 0 49 
The stock market traded near the flatline in afternoon trading Monday. Apple (AAPL) was mostly flat after rising 0.7% early. 
X 
The Nasdaq composite edged higher by 0.2%. The S&P 500 added 0.1% and the Dow Jones industrial average was mostly flat. Volume on the NYSE and Nasdaq was tracking lower than Friday’s levels at the same time of day. 
The 10-year Treasury yield edged up 2 basis points to around 2.98%. 
Heavy-volume gainers in the stock market today included TCF Financial (TCF). Shares jumped 6% to 24.11. The Minnesota-based regional bank is still well within buy range from a 23.90 entry. Apple Stock Down 5% Last Week 
Apple had a bad week ahead of its May 1 earnings report. A cautious note from Morgan Stanley and a weak sales outlook from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) weighed. TSM is a big Apple supplier and cited weak smartphone demand.’ 
In related news, the European Union on Monday said its taking a closer look at Apple’s planned acquisition of music-identification service Shazam. 
Shares of Lululemon Athletica (LULU) were weak early, hurt by a Needham downgrade to hold from buy. But the athletic apparel retailer recovered well off session lows. Lululemon has been a top Leaderboard performer. 
Elsewhere, Halliburton (HAL) edged lower on mixed Q1 results, while toymaker Hasbro (HAS) reversed higher despite a sales miss. IBD 50 Winners 
Top gainers in the IBD 50 included Stamps.com (STMP), Grubhub (GRUB) and SVB Financial (SIVB). 
Stamps.com is still in buy range from a 215.86 buy point after a low-volume breakout. 
IBD 50 names performed well overall, with 14 up 1% or more. 
After the close, watch for earnings from Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL) and TD Ameritrade (AMTD). 
Shares of Alphabet rose 4% last week but ended just below the 10-week moving average. TD Ameritrade has a healthier chart as it carves a flat base with a 63.11 entry.
